#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 1 << 21;
const double PI = acos(-1.0);

vector<double> cs(MAXN), sn(MAXN), csi(MAXN), sni(MAXN);

void initTrig() {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
        cs[i] = cos(2 * PI * i / MAXN);
        sn[i] = sin(2 * PI * i / MAXN);
        csi[i] = cos(-2 * PI * i / MAXN);
        sni[i] = sin(-2 * PI * i / MAXN);
    }
}

struct InputReader {
    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    static int reverseBits(int x, int bits) {
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < bits; i++) {
            res = (res << 1) | (x & 1);
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
        int n = a.size();
        int bits = 0;
        int temp = n;
        while (temp > 1) {
            temp >>= 1;
            bits++;
        }
        vector<int> rev(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            rev[i] = reverseBits(i, bits);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = rev[i];
            if (i < j) {
                swap(a[i], a[j]);
                swap(b[i], b[j]);
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int w = MAXN / len;
                for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < halfLen; j++, k += w) {
                    double wA = inverse ? csi[k] : cs[k];
                    double wB = inverse ? sni[k] : sn[k];
                    double uA = a[i + j];
                    double uB = b[i + j];
                    double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }

    static vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = 2;
        while (n < need) n <<= 1;

        vector<double> aReal(n, 0), aImaginary(n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

        vector<double> bReal(n, 0), bImaginary(n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

        vector<double> faReal(n), faImaginary(n), fbReal(n), fbImaginary(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
            double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

            faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

            fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
        fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);
        vector<int> res(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
            long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
            long long cc = (long long)(faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
            res[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static vector<int> powPoly(const vector<int>& base, int exp, int mod) {
        if (exp == 0) {
            return vector<int>(1, 1);
        }
        vector<int> half = powPoly(multiplyMod(base, base, mod), exp / 2, mod);
        if ((exp & 1) == 0) {
            return half;
        } else {
            return multiplyMod(base, half, mod);
        }
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int mod = 998244353;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = in.nextInt();
            v[x] = 1;
        }
        vector<int> ans = powPoly(v, n / 2, mod);
        int res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (int)((res + (long long)x * x) % mod);
        }
        out << res << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    initTrig();
    InputReader in;
    Solver solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
